## Description

A flaw was found in SciPy, where it is vulnerable to a denial of service caused by a use-after-free bug in the Py\_FindObjects() function. By sending a specially crafted request, an attacker can cause a denial of service condition.

#### Red Hat CVSS v3 Score Explanation

In order to exploit this vulnerability the attacker would have to call ndimage.find\_objects, at which point the caller already can execute arbitrary Python code - and then there are far more impactful things they can do than cause a small memory leak,which is why this should not be considered a valid CVE at all.

## Understanding the Weakness (CWE)

### Integrity

Technical Impact: Modify Memory [...] The use of previously freed memory may corrupt valid data, if the memory area in question has been allocated and used properly elsewhere.

### Availability

Technical Impact: DoS: Crash, Exit, or Restart

If chunk consolidation occurs after the use of previously freed data, the process may crash when invalid data is used as chunk information.

### Confidentiality

Technical Impact: Read Memory
